get.description: List Wbs Code for a given project

parameters.name: filters[id]
parameters.description: Return item(s) with the specified IDs.

parameters.name: filters[search]
parameters.description: Returns item(s) matching the specified search query string.

parameters.name: filters[scope]
parameters.description: Restricts results to a specific code scope. 'budget_code' returns codes used for budget line items; 'production_quantity_code' returns codes used for production quantity tracking.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Return groups with the specified filter ID. Supported values: `status`, `segment_id-tier_depth`. For example: `group=500-1` will return objects with all values of tier 2 of the segment with id 500.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link

attribute_1_name.description: Display name of the attribute item assigned to the first WBS Attribute slot for this code. Null when no attribute item has been assigned to attribute position 1.

attribute_2_name.description: Display name of the attribute item assigned to the second WBS Attribute slot for this code. Null when no attribute item has been assigned to attribute position 2.

attribute_3_name.description: Display name of the attribute item assigned to the third WBS Attribute slot for this code. Null when no attribute item has been assigned to attribute position 3.

code.description: Formatted WBS code string — a concatenation of the segment items' codes in pattern order, delimited by '.'. Use to display or search for a specific budget code (e.g. "09.L", "15.O.P2").

description.description: Human-readable description of this WBS code. Defaults to a concatenation of the segment items' names in pattern order, delimited by '.'. Null when not explicitly set.

id.description: Unique string identifier for this WBS Code. Use to filter the list endpoint with filters[id][]=value, or as input to the /codes/attribute_items assign/unassign endpoints.

status.description: Availability status of this WBS code. 'active' means the code is visible and available for selection in budget pickers; 'inactive' means the code is hidden and cannot be assigned to new line items. Filter by  status using filters[status] on GET .../codes or in the /codes/ids request body.

parameters.name: Procore-Company-Id

get.description: List Wbs Code IDs for a given project

schema.description: Request body for fetching WBS code IDs with filtering options. All filters within a single filter object are applied as AND conditions, while multiple filter objects in the array are combined with OR logic.

items.description: The WBS Code Filter is used to filter WBS codes based on various criteria. All criteria within a single filter object are applied as AND conditions.

id.description: Array of WBS Code string IDs to include. Returns only codes whose id matches one of the provided values.

scope.description: Scope of WBS codes to return. 'budget_code' returns codes used for budget line items; 'production_quantity_code' returns codes used for production quantity tracking.

search.description: Free-text search term. Matches against the WBS code string, description, and the names of assigned attribute items.

segment_item.description: Array of segment item filters. Each object restricts results to codes that include a segment item at the given segment and tier. Multiple objects within the array are combined with AND logic.

id.description: Array of Segment Item string IDs to match within the specified segment and tier. Null entries are permitted to match codes with no item at that tier.

segment_id.description: String ID of the WBS Segment to filter within. Retrieve valid segment IDs from GET .../work_breakdown_structure/segments.

tier_depth.description: 0-based tier depth within the segment hierarchy to target (0 = top level, 1 = second level, etc.). Use with tiered segments to filter on a specific level.

status.description: Lifecycle status of WBS codes to return. 'active' returns codes available for selection; 'inactive' returns hidden codes.

Per-Page.description: Number of items retrieved per page

Total.description: Total number of items to be retrieved

Link.description: Link headers for the first, prev, next, and last link
